programme.title: Till We Meet Again

programme.title: One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A noble swordsman, whose arm had been chopped off, returns to his former teacher to defend him from a villainous gang of rival swordsmen.

programme.title: Voyage Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the generals escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-An
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70s Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong’s disciples and frames him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel and she hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner are on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and which can only be destroyed by the Kan curved sword.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges

programme.title: Whose Baby Is In Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. His class helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching.

programme.title: Two Champions Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Wang Yu witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by Yuen Wahs vicious villain. Although he escapes, the killer saw the large eagle emblazoned on our heros chest.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Alex is happily married to a gynecologist, Tung for five years. When Alex is fatally wounded in an accident, he feels obliged to tell Tung about his affair with Blackie.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: When her father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era, a young girl has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and set out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, however, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf for winning the lantern contest. At the same time, Zhao plans for revenge.

programme.title: Brothers From The Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloons Walled City take markedly different life paths. Chin gets a job working at a cabaret, while Kang is drawn into the sleazy underworld.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Disciples Of The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Legendary martial arts director Lau Kar-leung strikes gold directing half-brother Gordon Liu as golden-robed monk San Te, who reprises his role from The 36th Chamber of Shaolin.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Tang Peng Nan are a sweet couple. She sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan at a time when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by him, leading to their break up.

programme.title: The Spirit Of The Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Taihu Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him.

programme.title: The Mirror And The Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story between the scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: A bizarre yet beautiful fantasy, starring Lin Dai as a goddess who falls in love with a scholar. 14 years later their son seeks to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Peter Chen Ho is the suave playboy gallivanting across Asia, while having his way with three unsuspecting sisters, setting in motion a parade of mishaps and comic interludes.

programme.title: Arjuna In Switzerland
programme.desc: "Arjuna in Switzerland" is a culinary travel show featuring Chef Juna exploring Switzerlands natural beauty and culture, tasting local dishes, and sharing unique experiences.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: After an explosion kills Yin Ching, Lou feels drawn to Lam Yam, her lookalike. Both loved Lou, but had different backgrounds. Chings vengeful plan stemmed from Lou accidentally killing her mother years ago.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Wei Long travels to HK from Shanghai to pursue her education. As she struggles financially, she becomes her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks in a life of depravity.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs. Inspector Bong discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the country’s energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: One Second
programme.desc: The film is set during the Cultural Revolution, where a common man escapes a labour camp to find a newsreel that captures his daughter for one second in a movie.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon
programme.desc: Crippled Ho came to Hong Kong as an illegal immigrant in 1963 and ruthlessly carved an empire from the chaotic underworld of drug dealers and corrupt police that ruled the city under notorious detective Lee Rock.

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol.

programme.title: Marrying Mr. Perfect
programme.desc: Winnie is dumped by her boyfriend in her late twenties and unknowingly meets Koo, a ruthless tycoon in business and a playboy. Koo temporarily switches identities with his driver for security reason and falls for Winnie as she is the first girl to love him for who he is. What will happen when Winnie know Koo’s real identity?

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. After giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: My Best Bet
programme.desc: A gambling addict and her anti-gambling husband face relationship challenges when she must return to her old ways after criminals target her family.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau 2
programme.desc: An Interpol agent, Vincent seeks the help of the God of Gamblers, Ken in busting the mastermind of an international crime syndicate.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Fok Kit is the hottest underground boxer with unbeatable records. To save their boxing studio from being sold, he must win the fight against Shaolin who is known as "Killing Machine". Fok Kit is defeated and badly hurt in the fight, which is a set-up by Lok, who wants to take revenge on Fok Kit’s master, Debo.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence, landslides, and put a town nearby are at stake. Will the authority blow up the tunnel?

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: The bus driver got injured while rescuing one of the boys at school bus accident. To thank the driver, the boys dad, brings him to live with the family. But soon discovers strange behaviours from them.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: A prosecutor on his last case deals with a colleague to exonerate a suspect, making the law just.

programme.title: American Dreams In China
programme.desc: During the economic reform period in the 80s, three undergraduates are brought together by a common ambition, to live the American dream.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: An unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung’s mad fate?

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: The movie depicts how the fathers forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the fighting spirit through generations.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Fat, who suffers from amnesia, believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters best ally.

programme.title: Once In A Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei-chun longs to reunite with her estranged father, her brother conceals his separation from his wife, and their mother harbors guilt over her husbands past departure. Can this troubled family overcome secrets and reconcile?

programme.desc: Launched on Jan. 1, 2011, CGTN Documentary is the only Chinese TV channel to broadcast documentaries in English 24/7. The channel broadcasts over 1,000 episodes of new programs each year, including top quality documentaries such as “A Bite of China”, “Wild Wonders”, and the 100-episode “A History of China”. CGTN Documentary is an ideal platform for people around the world to learn about Chinas past and present, and is dedicated to promoting the best of Chinese documentaries.
